import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().split("\n")
    k = int(lines[0])
    free_at = [0] * k
    served = left = max_wait = 0
    queue = []
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[1:], 1):
        parts = line.split()
        if not parts:
            continue
        name, arrival, duration, patience = parts[0], int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]), int(parts[3])
        queue.append((name, arrival, duration, patience))

    for name, arrival, duration, patience in queue:
        earliest_s = max(arrival, *free_at)
        counter = free_at.index(min(free_at))
        wait = earliest_s - arrival
        if wait > patience:
            print(f"{name} left")
            left += 1
        else:
            free_at[counter] = earliest_s + duration
            print(f"{name} {counter + 1} {earliest_s} {earliest_s + duration}")
            served += 1
            max_wait = max(max_wait, wait)

    print(f"served {served} left {left} max wait {max_wait}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
